headline: Sundaram Multi Pap submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine paperwork filed after September meeting
summary: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited has submitted its annual general meeting scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange following the meeting held on September 29, 2026. This is a standard corporate compliance filing required after shareholder meetings. For an Indian retail investor, routine AGM filings have no immediate financial impact on the company's stock performance.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio holdings.
